newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares firm, seen oscillating.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares firm, seen oscillating.

text.p: Slovenia's SBI index rebounded 0.69 percent on Thursday after two days of decline. Traders forecast the index would hold fairly stable over the next week.
"Heavy selling is not likely because the general feeling is that September will give a new push to prices as foreign and domestic demand is expected to increase significantly then," a trader said.
* The SBI index rose 10.5 points to 1,554.17.
* Drug company Lek was most actively traded, up 1.4 percent to 35,490 tolars on volume of 1,691 shares for a total turnover of 60 million tolars.
